gloss: to trample; to violate; to treat with contempt

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {踏|ふ}みにじりませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {踏|ふ}みにじっていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {踏|ふ}みにじっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to trample underfoot; to stamp on
definitions.explanation: To crush something by stepping on it forcefully and grinding it.

definitions.gloss: to violate; to trample on (rights, feelings); to treat with contempt
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to disregard or cruelly violate someone's rights, dignity, or feelings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}みにじった。
タバコ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{吸|す}い{殻|がら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{踏|ふ}みにじった。
examples.english: He crushed the cigarette butt under his shoe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あ}らされ→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧、⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{踏|ふ}みにじられた。
examples.english: Her field was devastated and the crops trampled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}みにじる⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧だ。
examples.english: It is an act that tramples on human rights.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}みにじるようなこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Don't say things that trample on his feelings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}みにじった⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Harsh criticism was directed at the politician who trampled on the people's trust.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is more common in modern usage than the literal sense. Often appears in news reporting and formal writing about rights violations or betrayals of trust.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}みにじる (to violate human rights)
- ⟦{尊厳|そんげん}→尊厳：12387_songen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}みにじる (to trample on dignity)
- {気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}みにじる (to trample on someone's feelings)
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}みにじる (to betray trust)

FORMS:
Compound verb from ⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ (to step on) + にじる (to crush by grinding). The second element にじる is rarely used independently.
